question: Does leave-one-source-task-out chronological prediction provide a consistent source-only signal for retaining or adapting the source risk prior on compatible tasks?
reconstruction: Regenerate only the exact previously paid source labels using the frozen V6 source_data/prepare_sources seeds and protocol; no new observation seeds, source tasks or target data.
prior_fit: For each archive/task fold, exclude every label of the held source function. Refit the original full source eta prior and original source-risk ARD on the other seven tasks, reusing one fold fit for both predictive controls. Keep the original public 96-candidate normalization bank and source-ARD optimizer settings.
prediction: Treat the held source function as a pseudo-target. Its existing outcome-free source point order supplies the first 24 old observations. At each step use strictly earlier labels; compare original source P0, adapted-only P1 and unchanged A9 on the next old label. All source generating supports are metadata only, never fitting inputs.
analysis: Report all archive groups and both priors. First average the 16 next-label gains within a held task, then all eight held tasks within an archive; paired bootstrap units are the 16 seed archives, not individual labels or overlapping source folds.
purpose: Diagnose whether source-only held-task prediction can inform future adaptation-strength learning. This stage fits no new calibration rule, uses no target outcomes and selects no winning variant.
scope: Within each archive, held source tasks retain its generating risk support. Supports vary across archives, but no archive contains high-frequency risk or within-archive support-shift examples. Do not infer out-of-distribution adaptation quality from this compatible-task diagnosis.
source_costs: All labels belong to existing source archives. Report original per-archive source costs separately; the diagnosis adds computation but no simulation calls.
resource_admission: Measure the first complete learned-source fold including seven-task ARD refit and both control paths; retain it and forecast all 256 folds. Stop with partial evidence if the forecast exceeds 900 local CPU seconds; do not shrink the cohort or dispatch jobs.
implementation_checks: The held function never enters covariance/intercept learning; source priors are shared across its two controls; only earlier held-function observations reach issued predictions; fold and seed grouping match the fixed cohort.
decision: A coherent source-only predictive signal permits designing a separate offline calibration protocol. A weak or conflicting signal ends this diagnosis without automatic model expansion. Prospective target searches and recommendation replay remain on hold.
limitations: Development source archives associated with the reused V6 seed blocks, not independent confirmation. The diagnostic cannot establish high-frequency or support-shift transfer, KG acquisition value, high-dimensional representation learning or deployment gains.
secondary_diagnostic: Learned-source P0 minus generic-source P0 on identical held functions and point order; keep separate from the adaptation question.
optimizer_reporting: Report every original source-ARD fold convergence flag and iteration count; no fallback or optimizer retuning.
